title: Deferred-finding issues enter the delivery loop

story.i_want_to: an issue labelled deferred-finding on an enrolled repository to be triaged, built, verified and merged by the delivery loop
story.so_that: routed review findings (148 in the 30 days to 2026-11-07: HCB 118, claude-config 20, loopctl 10) stop costing an interactive session each

rationale: US-48.15 ranked this first: the largest measured recurring stream, each finding already carries a failure scenario, and the work runs on triage@1, implement@1 and verify@1 as they are. SOUL rule 0 routes a pre-existing defect in an unchanged file to a deferred-finding issue.

acceptance_criteria.description: An intake source carries an admission rule, admit_labels (a list, default empty), next to triage_requires_ticket; an issue carrying one of the listed labels is admitted to triage even when triage_requires_ticket is true. The rule filters on the label only; it authenticates nothing.
The implementer sees only the story triage drafted; the issue body stays in untrusted_* fields and passes the injection screen, as for any report.
Gate A and Gate B apply unchanged: a finding whose expected files hit a human path escalates at triage and at the merge gate.

The story is verified by verify@1 under VerifierPlacement's rules: a separately rooted dispatch, placed on a runner whose agent is neither the story's assigned agent nor the implementer dispatch's agent. While such a runner exists but is busy, the pass answers no_runner and a later pass retries; only when the tenant has no live runner of another agent does the story escalate over no_independent_verifier_runner.

The story's outcome row (US-48.12) records triage human override, merge gate decision, review finding count by severity, verify verdict, merged, and reverted-within-14-days; Agents.Outcomes.summary can filter by admission label.
intake_source_update accepts admit_labels, the MCP tool documents it in the same change, and deploy/FLY_SECRETS.md needs no row (no new env var).

test_cases.name: a labelled issue is admitted past the ticket filter
steps: source with triage_requires_ticket true and admit_labels [deferred-finding]
deliver an issue carrying deferred-finding and no ticket footer
expected_results: an unlabelled issue on the same source is not admitted

test_cases.name: a human-path finding escalates
steps: triage verdict story whose expected files match a Gate B human path

test_cases.name: outcome row carries the label
steps: run a labelled story to merged
expected_results: one outcome row with every signal and the admission label

test_cases.name: tenant isolation
steps: two tenants each admit a labelled issue

technical_notes: Enable on home_care_billing first; claude-config has no Gate B entry, so every change there escalates, which is the intended behaviour (agent-delivery-loop.md, Gate B).
